motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances, press feedback and directional response.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary project action on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink, #071d31); color: var(--paper-bright, #fbf8f1); font: 700 10px/1 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--ink-raised, #163650); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-soft, #d1b475); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Primary project action on navy surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-accent { min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: var(--gold-soft, #d1b475); color: var(--ink, #071d31); font: 700 10px/1 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-accent:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #dfc991; } .ds-button-accent:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-soft, #d1b475); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-accent:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: Square field for the navy contact panel.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; color: #dfe3e4; font: 600 11px/1.4 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 50px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(241,234,223,.36); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.045); color: var(--paper-bright, #fbf8f1); font: 400 15px/1.5 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgba(209,180,117,.72); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gold-soft, #d1b475); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(209,180,117,.17); background: rgba(255,255,255,.075); }

components.name: Capability Ledger Row
components.description: Ruled service row with number, title and explanation.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { min-height: 92px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 120px 1fr 22px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid rgba(7,29,49,.19); color: var(--ink, #071d31); font-family: Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-row span { color: var(--gold, #87591a); font: 500 11px/1 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; } .ds-ledger-row strong { font-size: 12px; } .ds-ledger-row p { color: #394b58; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-ledger-row b { color: var(--gold, #87591a); font-weight: 400; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-ledger-row:hover b { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Tracked utility navigation with a measured gold underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 38px; color: var(--ink, #071d31); font: 700 10px/1 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 20px 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 12px; height: 1px; background: var(--gold, #87591a); transition: right 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { right: 0; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-soft, #d1b475); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet architectural world where warm paper, a real arch and Ionic column, physical strategy folios and a bronze turtle medallion make AI feel considered, useful and human-led. A sculpted threshold leads into midnight navy chapters while antique gold remains a scarce functional marker.
keyCharacteristics: Bronze turtle medallion inset into limestone

rules.name: The Scarce Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks hierarchy, actions and measurement lines; it never becomes a decorative field.

rules.name: The Material-First Rule
rules.body: Show depth through real imagery or tonal layers before adding shadow.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif carries meaning and atmosphere; sans serif carries navigation, explanation and action.

dos: Preserve the statement, arch, full column, folios and navy threshold as the first-screen memory.
Use real architectural imagery with intentional crops.
Use the bronze turtle medallion as a physical signature object.
Keep legal and form states explicit and accessible.
donts: Introduce glowing AI gradients or neon circuitry.
Turn capabilities into rounded icon-card grids.
Invent commercial proof or nutrition claims.
